label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy's Collapse
items.text: Rory McIlroy's third-round eight-hole stretch with four bogeys and a double bogey ended his chances to win the DP World India Championship in New Delhi.

items.headline: Min Woo Lee Withdraws
items.text: Min Woo Lee withdrew from the DP World India Championship due to a stomach illness, removing a top contender from the $4 million event.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Cheating Accusation
items.text: Tiger Woods was once accused of cheating while pursuing Jack Nicklaus' major record, highlighting controversy amid his prime dominance.
